title: plugin-auth: a SCIM bearer write that carries any Cookie and no Origin is refused 403 MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Found while fixing objectstack-ai/cloud#4491 (hosted SCIM writes refused). Measured in-process by the cloud os-dev agent through plugin-auth `handleRequest`, at cloud's framework pin c5758b0d.

## Measured

- `POST /api/v1/auth/scim/v2/Users` with a valid SCIM bearer and **no Cookie** answers 201.
- The same request with **any** `Cookie` header and no `Origin` answers **403 `MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN`**. The same holds for `PATCH … active:false`. This includes an unrelated edge cookie such as Cloudflare's `__cf_bm`, and expired names with empty values.
- Cause: better-auth 1.7.12 `validateOrigin` decides `useCookies = headers.has('cookie')` and then requires an Origin. plugin-auth forwards the Cookie header into the vendor on `/scim/v2/*` and does not exempt that path.
- `@better-auth/scim` authenticates `/scim/v2/*` by the bearer alone, so a cookie never carries authority there. The origin check protects nothing on this path; it only refuses real IdP clients that keep a cookie jar (Okta did on staging), or a sticky-session load-balancer cookie on self-hosted.
- The EE suite cannot see it: `apps/objectos-ee/test/scim-leaver-lifecycle.e2e.test.ts` (cloud repo) always sends an Origin.

## Expected

A `/scim/v2/*` request authenticated by a SCIM bearer is not subject to the browser origin/CSRF check. Either do not forward Cookie into the vendor on `/scim/v2/*`, or skip the origin check there for bearer-authenticated calls. Every cookie-authenticated browser route keeps its origin check.

## Acceptance

- A SCIM bearer POST and PATCH carrying a Cookie and no Origin succeed.
- A cookie-authenticated non-SCIM POST with no Origin is still refused (a positive control).
- A SCIM POST with a cookie and no bearer is still refused.

The cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4498 carries a hosted proxy strip of the same shape. Whether it lands as a transition is the maintainer's decision on cloud#4491. Once this ships in a release and cloud's pin carries it, that strip retires.

Carrier: objectstack. Triage sets the lane and the level.
